scope: Three semantic-support sources additional to the thirteen inputs needed to regenerate register and clock-name tables. These pins establish software CCF projection rules, not analog measurement or complete Lenovo source identity.

rules.generic_outdiv_bit_pixel: Each CCF clk_regmap_div recalculation calls divider_recalc_rate; for a nonzero divisor it rounds upward independently at each level.
rules.fixed_factor: clk_factor_recalc_rate multiplies in 64 bits, then do_div truncates; fixed-factor views use floor.
rules.zero_divider: The CCF ALLOW_ZERO fallback returns parent rate; that fallback does not prove a physical zero-coded divisor. The bounded DSI reference keeps zero bit/pixel dividers without a known carrier.
rules.period_projection: Integer CCF projection rules are followed by QEMU Clock period quantization; comparison must distinguish mathematical integer Hz from a period-derived Hz observation.
